title: Zumba with B
lines: Experience high-energy, fun-filled Zumba sessions in Paris designed for all fitness levels. Burn calories, boost your mood, and join our vibrant community today.
A high-energy cardio dance workout set to upbeat Latin and international rhythms. Perfect for all experience levels to let loose, burn calories, and smile.
"It becomes more than just a class, it is your weekly get away where you can really just be you."
Grab a single class pass, secure a multi-session pack, or join our community WhatsApp group for real-time schedule updates and Parisian dance events.
Find quick answers about session locations, what to wear, online payments, and how to stay connected with our Paris dance community.
Do I need prior dance experience?
Not at all! Every choreography is structured with easy-to-follow steps. It is all about moving to the music and having fun at your own pace.
What should I wear and bring?
Wear supportive indoor sneakers and comfortable athletic clothing. Don't forget a refillable water bottle and a small sweat towel!
How do I purchase session passes online?
You can purchase individual drop-in passes or multi-class packages directly through our Pricing & Passes page securely using card payment.
How do I join the WhatsApp group?
You can sign up via our contact section or send an email to receive weekly updates, schedule announcements, and direct WhatsApp group invite links.

For class booking cancellations, please contact me directly. Cancellations made more than 24 hours before the class start time will receive a 100% refund for that class. Cancellations made within 24 hours of the class start time will receive a 50% refund. No-shows are not eligible for a refund.
Every Tuesday 8:45 PM (20 h 45) until 10:15 PM (22 h 15)
